mensagens.input: Scott and Greg both are students at the Carmite Middle School. Scott thinks he is always late to school because he lives too far away. One day, they compared the distances they must travel to figure out who lives farther.
Scott travels 13/10 miles to get to school.
Greg travels 5/3 miles to get to school.
-----,Yes; Scott is right. He does live farther away.,No; Scott is wrong. It is Greg who lives father away.,Both live the same distance from the school.
Who lives farther from the school?
